nodes.label: Merkle Patricia Trie Cryptographic State Verification Structure
nodes.description: Deterministic authenticated data structure combining Radix trees with cryptographic hash digests to provide sub-linear proofs of state inclusion and integrity for knowledge graph mutations.

nodes.label: Enhanced Khoja Root Extraction Algorithm for Classical and Modern Arabic
nodes.description: Algorithmic root extraction mechanism incorporating prefix/suffix stripping rules, dictionary validation, and pattern matching for classical and Modern Standard Arabic entity normalization.

nodes.label: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 Privacy Information Management System (PIMS)
nodes.description: International extension standard to ISO/IEC 27001 specifying data protection requirements and guidance for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) processing in sovereign enclaves.

nodes.label: RoCEv2 (RDMA over Converged Ethernet v2) Transport Protocol
nodes.description: UDP-encapsulated Remote Direct Memory Access protocol enabling zero-copy, kernel-bypass memory operations across high-throughput data center fabrics for NVMe-oF and distributed graph execution.

nodes.label: W3C RDF Schema (RDFS) Vocabulary Description Language Standard
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation providing basic structural elements and schema constructs for RDF graph data modeling, taxonomy hierarchies, and property domain/range declarations.
